raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "django-cloud-browser" %}
{% set version = "0.5.4" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 4de4ce8bbafc54289d6a7e8a424be9105b60f0cdca88cb61de7f43cf01e3ac36

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 3
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - setuptools
    - pip
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}

test:
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
  imports:
    - cloud_browser
    - cloud_browser.cloud
    - cloud_browser.templatetags

about:
  home: http://github.com/ryan-roemer/django-cloud-browser
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: "Django Cloud Browser application."
  dev_url: https://github.com/ryan-roemer/django-cloud-browser

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - mxr-conda
